title: Truvio distribution pipeline item manifest (pipelines/<name>/pipeline.json)
description: Contract schema for pipelines/<name>/pipeline.json. A pipeline item is one versioned unit of deploy tooling: the deploy core (engine-neutral scripts) or the templates of one pipeline engine that run it. Validated by tools/ci/Validate-Distribution.ps1; released as the annotated tag pipelines/<name>/<version>. Digit classes are written [0-9].

name.description: Item identity; equals the directory name and is part of the release tag.

version.description: Semver. Any change to a file of the item raises it; the tag pipelines/<name>/<version> names one tree only.

kind.description: deploy-core: the scripts every engine runs. pipeline-template: the templates of one engine.

entry.description: The file a consumer starts from, relative to the item's directory. Must exist.

core.description: The version of pipelines/core this item runs. Must equal pipelines/core/pipeline.json version: both ship from one commit.

proof.description: What has been measured, stated by the item itself. A pipeline item is deploy tooling: it is never part of layers/INDEX.json gateProven and proves no edition.

state.description: proven: the item has delivered an edition end to end as it ships. unproven: it has not run on its engine yet.
